model_bundle_contract.actual_context_gate: Parse INFO-level LLMModel initialized line; require loaded CL variants to include 4096. Account for image and prompt tokens in the same budget.

power.precedence: QAIRT wrapper sets ModelConfig.perf_profile on both LLM and vision; core resolveHtpPerfConfig applies this override after parsing bundle HTP config.
power.measurement_limit: Requested profile and source mapping do not measure watts or actual clock residency.
power.source_vote: Fixed QnnApi.cpp applies public setPowerConfig after context creation; sustained maps powerMode=0x10 and voltage corner=0x80, while burst uses corner=0x90.
power.success_log_limit: Fixed qnn-api/src/Log.hpp compiles QNN_INFO and QNN_WARN to no-ops. Successful power-vote logging is unavailable in this prebuilt source configuration; QNN_ERROR is retained.
power.error_gate: The probe records and rejects observed setPowerConfig/createPowerConfigId/deviceGetInfrastructure failures, without claiming absence of an error log measures the physical power state.
